release_notes: Product Master now has SKU Code Registration Mode for All SKU, Missing Scan Code Only, Batch SKU Only, and Missing Batch SKU queues.
Scanner registration keeps the scan field focused, handles Enter/Tab/newline suffixes, blocks duplicate active scan codes across different SKUs, and auto-advances after each save.
Packing App JSON/CSV export now blocks incomplete scan-code readiness unless an operator explicitly exports with warning exceptions.
Product Master and Output & Export can generate Code128 SKU Barcode Board PDFs for all SKUs or the latest allocation batch.
